Subject: Wrong charge on invoice NCS-4410 (Northgate Cloud Services Inc.)
TextBody:
Hello,

Your invoice NCS-4410 charges us for the 24/7 support plan twice (2 x 1,200.00 USD), but we only have one plan. Please correct the invoice and refund the duplicate 1,200.00 USD to our card.
